jobs.title: Quarterly Planning and Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**The Role:**

JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. You will also interface heavily with partner teams in product and technology organizations as we move towards more consistent approaches across these teams. This is a high\-intensity, high\-visibility execution role involving the creation of net\-new data\-driven, AI\- and ML\-based products with our diverse set of automotive data assets.  



The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real\-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. You will partner with Analytics leaders to identify, root cause and improve business performance, and evaluate and measure the impact of use of AI in our development teams.  



This role sits within the Transformation Office, the enterprise function responsible for orchestrating the programs and initiatives that underpin our three\-year strategy. In this capacity, you will be a dedicated execution partner to our CDAO, embedded in the work that matters most and positioned to grow alongside it.  



**The Impact You Will Have in This Role:**

Data and analytics are core to what JD Power sells and how we operate, particularly as our data assets and product development roadmaps have grown more complex and connected across multiple data sources. Your involvement in this position will ensure clarity of product development purpose and enable teams to effectively plan and ultimately own their development commitments. The Project Manager in this role is not a coordinator. You are voice of the Analytics organization in relation to what we shipped, what we will ship, how confident we are in doing so, and whether our quality, throughput and accuracy are performing to expectations.  



**What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:**

· Facilitate program increment quarterly planning events to align teams on a shared mission, objectives and delivery commitments each quarter. Lead inspect \& adapt workshops, facilitating quantitative and qualitative retrospectives and executing on improvement ideas


· Track and communicate metrics like completion rates, program predictability, to provide transparency and drive continuous improvement


· Leading end\-to\-end program delivery by coordinating across multiple teams and functions, adapting to methodologies as needed including Agile, hybrid, and data platform\-specific workflows


· Building, maintaining, and owning the committed project plan and schedule, distinct from the product roadmap, and ensuring milestones are met with transparency and rigor


· Drive adoption and maturity of product planning practices across the organization


· Applying a hybrid toolkit – technical project management, agile delivery, and business analysis to address the specific needs of each workstream


· Bring technical project management expertise to address engineering and AI challenges, working closely with technical leads and data scientists to monitor development progress and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.


· Partner with Analytics leaders to set annual KPI objectives for year\-on\-year improvements. Proactively measure and report out on those KPIs and partner with technical teams to uncover root causes, implement retrospective actions and identify risks and countermeasures  



**What You Bring**

· 5\-8 years of project management experience


· Highly accountable, you own your commitments, follow through without being chased, and hold others to the same standard


· A self\-starter who can operate with limited direction, identify what needs to happen next, and move without waiting to be told


· Strong communication skills, able to distill complex program status into clear, concise updates for leadership audiences, both written and verbal


· Experience in technology\-centric environments (software development, IT, or data) with a history of bridging business objectives and technical execution


· Proficiency in SAFe a plus. Proficiency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, generally speaking; experience with Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar SDLC and PM tools


· Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to program and project management workflows, and a track record of proactively exploring and adopting emerging AI capabilities to improve team productivity and decision\-making


· Strong RAID discipline, schedule management, budget oversight, and the instinct to track details without losing sight of the bigger picture.


· Comfortable managing multiple workstreams concurrently in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment


· Bachelor's degree preferred; PMP certification a plus


· North American based, with availability to work across a distributed global team.  



This position has a starting salary range of **$75,000 – $90,000 USD / 75,000 – 123,000 CAD** per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.  



  

  

**Why Join JD Power**

jobs.title: Project Manager - Special Projects and Innovation
jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance.

  

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high\-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

 **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

 **Position Title:** Project Manager \- Special Projects and Innovation

**Position Location:** Remote \- work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with travel to job sites and lab environments

 **JOB SUMMARY**

  

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance. The Special Projects and Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project: rapid proofs of concept, emerging technology evaluations, and first\-of\-their\-kind monitoring and analytics platforms for critical facilities.

  

As a Project Manager you will oversee the pursuit and delivery of SPI initiatives, from data pipelines and full\-stack applications for AI\-enabled data center monitoring to IoT sensor networks that stand up in the field in hours. You will guide initiatives from whiteboard concept through lab prototype, field pilot, and handoff to long\-term owners, coordinating technical leads, vendors, and project resources while managing budgets, schedules, and capacity across concurrent efforts.

  

The Project Manager will self\-direct on day\-to\-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. May coordinate activities of other personnel.

  

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

 **Program Oversight and Coordination (30%)**

* Ingest and evaluate unique initiatives entering the SPI pipeline
* Track resource allocation, budgets, and capacity across concurrent initiatives
* Identify, escalate, and drive resolution of project risks and blockers
* Coordinate across technical leads, vendors, project resources, and stakeholders to keep initiatives on schedule

 **Documentation and Reporting (20%)**

* Enforce regular reporting among the project team and review summaries and reports
* Draft program\-level summary reports and present during regular project updates
* Maintain documentation standards for product delivery

 **Implementation (20%)**

* Travel to job sites for system demonstrations and field pilots
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources to keep implementation on schedule

 **Project Closeout and Lifecycle (20%)**

* Facilitate the handoff of mature initiatives to long\-term owners and archive project documentation
* Coordinate project postmortems and lessons\-learned reviews for continuous program improvement
* Serve as the point of contact for client satisfaction and product lifecycle

 **Technology, Digital Tools \& AI\-Enabled Efficiency (10%)**

* Leverage AI\-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high\-quality work output
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance
* Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization

 **Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget**

*Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned*

 **POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)**

* Program and project management of multiple concurrent technical initiatives, including budgets, schedules, and resource allocation
* Project management and work tracking tools such as Smartsheet or similar
* Backlog and ticketing tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar
* Risk and blocker identification, escalation, and resolution across cross\-functional teams
* Vendor and stakeholder coordination, including scope, procurement, and delivery tracking
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle and BAS / IoT systems sufficient to coordinate engineering resources and review technical progress
* Knowledge of IoT and smart building solutions
* Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), knowledge of file management
* Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self\-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
* Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
* Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company\-wide innovation
* Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
* Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non\-technical information)
* Ability to communicate effectively directly with stakeholders and at times serve as primary point of client contact
* Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
* Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines

jobs.title: Program Manager, Rater & API Strategy
jobs.description:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1\) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2\) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3\) to protect the whole home.


As a leader in the home services software\-as\-a\-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home\-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.


In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

**Job Title:** Rater \& Agency Integration Program Manager

**Location:** United States

**Workplace Type:** Remote

**Job Summary**
---------------


The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as our Rater \& Agency Integration Program Manager.


Most of Porch's new insurance business flows through the comparative rater channel, making this role a direct driver of written premium growth. As Rater \& Agency Integration Program Manager, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and partner relationships for how comparative rating platforms — such as EZLynx, PL Rater, and Bolt — and large directly\-integrated agencies connect into our business. You will serve as the single accountable owner for getting new products, states, and brands live on rater platforms quickly and reliably, migrating legacy point\-to\-point integrations onto our Gateway API, and ensuring every live connection is optimized to maximize new business production. Operating at the intersection of engineering, product, distribution, and external partners, you will also serve as the technical bridge to our Sales and Distribution teams — providing scoping support for strategic prospects and ensuring agents have what they need to capture the rates they're eligible for.

This role is accountable for ensuring the right resources, governance, and methodologies are in place to enable successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex core SaaS system implementations for our clients, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, on budget, and with high CSAT scores.


In this capacity, the Project Manager partners closely with Customers, Sales Executives, Solution Consultants, Solution Architects, and Software Engineers to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and deliverables align with defined success criteria. By applying project management best practices and adhering to Bullhorn’s PMO processes, the Senior Project Manager defines, drives, and manages the delivery of projects, managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations to ensure an exceptional customer experience from project initiation through closure.  

  



**A typical day will include...**
---------------------------------

* **Owning the Project Lifecycle:** Lead the planning, execution, and closure of multiple, concurrent, large\-scale client software implementation projects, establishing the necessary governance and structure where none exists.
* **Proactively Drive Clarity and Order:** Quickly assess and gain command over complex, ambiguous, and high\-risk projects, translating chaos into defined, manageable, and executable project plans.
* **Ultimate Accountability:** Serve as the single point of accountability for project status and success. Naturally take ownership of problems and aggressively drive solutions to resolution.
* **Rigorous Risk and Scope Management:** Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks, dependencies, and issues. Firmly manage scope creep and hold both internal and client stakeholders accountable to agreed\-upon project plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Executive\-Level Communicatio** n: Manage client and vendor relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for project status, expectations, and issue resolution with executive and C\-level stakeholders.
* **Financial and Resource Control:** Oversee project budgets, tracking hours and expenses to ensure financial targets are met and providing accurate, predictable and insightful forecasting and reporting.
* **Methodology Adherence:** Apply project management best practices and actively contribute to the development, improvement and standardization of Bullhorn's PMO processes.
* Mentoring and provide guidance to junior project managers or implementation specialists on best practices and project governance.

**This role is a fit for you if...**
------------------------------------

* Have 3\+ years of progressive experience managing complex, external client\-facing software implementation projects, with a significant focus on ERP, HCM, CRM, or large\-scale SaaS solutions with billable utilization targets.
* A proven track record of successfully delivering projects that have a high level of complexity and ambiguity, demonstrating the ability to rapidly impose structure and governance.
* An expertise in defining and managing project scope, schedules, and budgets for large enterprise clients.
* A mastery of various project management methodologies ( *e.g.,* Waterfall, Scrum, Hybrid) and knowing when to apply each to achieve stability.
* A solid understanding of the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, configuration, data migration, integration, testing (UAT), and go\-live.
* Have a proficiency with modern project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, SmartSheet) and resource management systems.
* PMP, CSM, or equivalent is highly preferred.

The annual base salary range for this position is $92,002 \- $115,000\. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target bonus \& a comprehensive benefits package.

The posted range represents the good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Cycle Strategy and Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **About us**



Pomelo Care is the leading virtual medical practice for women and children, providing care across pregnancy, postpartum, pediatrics, menopause, and perimenopause. We combine proactive, 24/7 clinical care with technology that helps us reach patients earlier, identify risks sooner, and deliver personalized care throughout their journey. Our team includes clinicians, technologists, operators, and problem\-solvers working together to make high\-quality care more accessible for families nationwide.

### **About The Role:**


**Your north star:** To serve as a trusted strategic partner that enables sustainable growth and high\-quality patient care through rigorous financial stewardship, data\-driven insights, and operational excellence.



As the Senior Revenue Cycle Strategy and Operations Manager, you will sit at the intersection of strategic RCM, financial collaboration, data analytics, and operational project management. In our fast\-growing startup environment, we operate across multiple complex lines of business, ranging from a per engaged member per month (PEMPM) capitation model to highly specialized Fee\-For\-Service (FFS) lines with new novel models being piloted. In this role, you will step up to navigate complex commercial agreements to secure high\-value partnerships and improve deal velocity, design novel FFS/PEMPM hybrid billing structures to unlock additional revenue opportunities, and serve as the dedicated resource for high\-level RCM escalations that currently flow directly to leadership.



This role reports to the Head of RCM and is open to any candidates located in the continental US.


**What you'll do:**


* Partner with Finance and Sales to design competitive pricing strategies, build hybrid FFS/PEMPM billing models, and lead RCM onboarding for new B2B clients.
* Serve as the dedicated resolution point for high\-level RCM escalations to streamline operations and protect leadership bandwidth.
* Collaborate with internal tech teams to build, optimize, and scale proprietary RCM software, maintaining data integrity across EHRs, clearinghouses, and BI platforms.
* Monitor regulatory updates, healthcare policy shifts, and payer rule changes to evaluate their financial impact and adapt systems preemptively.
* Use BI tools and advanced financial modeling to analyze key performance metrics, audit billing workflows, reconcile payments, and surface denial patterns.
* Develop quality assurance frameworks, standard operating procedures, and audit guidelines to elevate operational rigor.
* Oversee day\-to\-day revenue cycle execution—including claims submission, clearinghouse error resolution, payment posting, and root\-cause denial prevention.


**Who You Are:**


* 5–7 years of healthcare revenue cycle experience, ideally within a healthcare startup, digital health company, or a multi\-specialty group.
* Proven ability to partner with Finance to design pricing structures and collaborate with Product/Tech to build scalable operational tools.
* Deep understanding of commercial and Medicaid insurance billing, claim formats, and denial resolution.
* Experience leading coding discussions and navigating non\-traditional or emerging healthcare benefits (like doula care or value\-based capitation models) is highly preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel. Experience writing basic SQL or using BI tools like Metabase, Tableau, or Looker to pull data is highly preferred, alongside leveraging AI to improve efficiency and effectiveness of work products.
* Proven track record of managing high\-impact projects, implementing new software configurations, and building cross\-departmental consensus as a senior individual contributor.
* A builder and a strategist. You thrive in ambiguity, take pride in resolving complex organizational headwinds, and enjoy designing "how things should work" rather than just following an old playbook.

### **Why you should join our team**



By joining Pomelo, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast\-moving, well\-funded, and mission\-driven startup that always puts the patient first. You will learn, grow and be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.



We strive to create an environment where employees from all backgrounds are respected. We value working across disciplines, moving fast, data\-driven decision making, learning, and always putting the patient first.


**Benefits and Perks:**


* Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees and their families
* High deductible Health Plans with Health Savings Account (HSA) options
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Equity grant participation
* 401(k) program
* Competitive vacation policy
* 16 weeks paid parental leave
* Fully remote work flexibility (within the US)


**Compensation:**


The expected base salary range offered for this role is $135,000\-$150,000\. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and equity, giving you an ownership stake in Pomelo's mission. Actual compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.



At Pomelo, we are committed to hiring the best team to improve outcomes for all mothers and babies, regardless of their background. We need diverse perspectives to reflect the diversity of problems we face and the population we serve. We look to hire people from a variety of backgrounds, including but not limited to race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status.

USDA’s oversight of the organic marketplace depends on integrating data that lives in different places: organic trade flows, Customs and Border Protection import data from the Automated Commercial Environment (ACE), NOP’s complaint and investigation records, accreditation data, appeals data, and market research. The Data Analyst brings these sources together to identify trends, surface risks, and give NOP leadership clear, decision\-ready analysis — roughly one significant analytical project per month, plus a monthly complaint and investigation trend report.

This role is about analysis, not tool\-building: the work uses existing USDA data and existing tools (Excel, Power BI or similar, and standard analytical software) to answer questions the program needs answered.

Core availability for interaction with USDA staff is 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern, Monday through Friday. Government\-furnished laptops are provided.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Integrate and analyze data across organic trade, ACE import records, compliance and enforcement, accreditation, appeals, and market research sources
* Produce a monthly data and trend analysis of complaints and investigations
* Deliver approximately one significant analytical project per month as assigned by NOP (e.g., import risk profiling, certifier performance comparison, supply chain anomaly analysis, market condition assessments)
* Perform data validation and quality control on structured and semi\-structured datasets
* Translate findings into clear narrative summaries, tables, and visualizations for program and leadership audiences
* Support market research on domestic and international dynamics affecting organic supply chains and program integrity
* Collaborate with the compliance, accreditation, and appeals analysts to answer data questions arising from their casework

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 3\+ years of applied data analysis experience, preferably supporting a government program, regulatory function, or trade/market analysis
* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, Power Query, complex formulas) and experience with at least one of: Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, or R
* Experience working with large datasets, including cleaning, validating, and reconciling data from multiple sources
* Demonstrated ability to identify trends and communicate data\-driven insights to non\-technical decision\-makers in writing and visually
* Ability to handle sensitive and Privacy Act–protected data

**PEFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with U.S. trade or customs data (ACE, Census trade data, HTS codes, import/export records)
* Familiarity with agricultural supply chains, commodity markets, or the organic sector

* Master’s degree in a quantitative field

jobs.title: Program Manager, HR Compliance
jobs.description:
**About the team**
------------------

The HR Compliance team is part of Zillow's Employee Service \& Operations (ES\&O) organization. ES\&O focuses on delivering scalable, reliable services that support employees and managers across the company, bringing together operational expertise, systems, and shared services that enable Zillow's people processes to run smoothly.
  

Within ES\&O, the HR Compliance team serves as Zillow's center of expertise for HR compliance — establishing the standards, guardrails, and governance frameworks that keep people practices legally sound as the business grows. The team partners closely with the broader People organization, Legal, and other shared services to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance, enabling operational teams to execute compliantly and consistently.
**About the role**
------------------

The Program Manager, HR Compliance is a subject matter expert responsible for helping strengthen Zillow's HR compliance program across a defined and expanding portfolio of programs.


This role supports regulatory monitoring, risk assessment, and policy governance work that allows the team to monitor and respond to changes in employment laws and regulations, identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risk, and equip HR partners with the guidance they need to operate compliantly. You will establish standards, playbooks, and controls for teams to execute against.


**You Will:**
-------------

* Monitor new and emerging employment regulations across U.S. federal, state, and international jurisdictions
* Develop and maintain a compliance register and ownership mapping, ensuring risks and obligations are documented, assigned, and tracked
* Develop and maintain compliance playbooks and operating standards that serve as the authoritative reference for operational teams executing programs
* Support international employment compliance governance across multiple jurisdictions, partnering with regional HR and People Legal on country\-specific regulatory obligations
* Maintain audit\-ready compliance controls and documentation across the program portfolio; coordinate internal and external audit activity, owning documentation standards, evidence organization, and audit response coordination in partnership with People Legal
* Support preparation and submission of statutory government reports, including mandated federal and state workforce filings
* Serve as a subject matter expert and advisory resource for stakeholder teams on compliance requirements
* Establish and communicate the compliance guardrails that operational teams execute against, ensuring consistent application of standards across programs
* Support development and implementation of actionable, accessible guidance
* Contribute to compliance education efforts, helping stakeholders understand the intent and practical application of requirements

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.
In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $90,900\.00 \- $145,100\.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $86,300\.00 \- $137,900\.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.
In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.
**Who you are**
---------------

* You treat compliance as a discipline with standards, not a set of tasks to complete. You understand the regulatory intent behind requirements and can communicate it clearly to partners who don't work in this space
* You are skilled at identifying risk before it becomes an issue, and you know how to document, escalate, and track it with rigor.
* You draw a clear line between setting the standard and executing against it, and you hold that line in how you structure partnerships with operational teams.
* You work confidently across jurisdictions and regulatory frameworks, and you know when a question requires legal escalation versus when you can resolve it directly.
* You build credibility through accuracy, follow\-through, and the quality of your documentation.
* You are organized and deadline\-driven, and you can manage multiple programs simultaneously without details falling through.

* Working knowledge of U.S. employment laws and regulatory frameworks, including FLSA, EEO, FCRA, and related requirements
* Experience with compliance risk identification, gap assessment, or audit coordination
* Demonstrated ability to manage HR policy governance processes, including review cycles, version control, and legal alignment
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with a track record of managing multiple concurrent compliance programs

----------------------------

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.

The role combines project leadership with technical facilities expertise to ensure offices are well designed, efficiently operated, sustainable, secure, and aligned with consistent standards. It leads complex design, construction, renovation, and infrastructure initiatives while developing scalable solutions across building systems, energy and sustainability, physical security, occupancy, and facilities operations.


Supporting a portfolio of more than 40 locations, this role translates global workplace strategy into repeatable, sound solutions while adapting to local requirements. Reporting to the Director, Global Workplace, the position partners with regional facilities teams, business leaders, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, landlords, vendors, sustainability and security teams, and other senior stakeholders.


This role provides meaningful visibility across global workplace initiatives and the opportunity to influence how Genesys facilities evolve as the portfolio and workplace needs change. Through close partnership across regions and functions, the role helps create reliable, sustainable, and effective workplaces that support employees and the broader business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Leadership \& Delivery**

* Lead multiple concurrent workplace design, construction, renovation, infrastructure, and facilities improvement projects from planning and due diligence through design, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
* Act as an owner\-focused project lead, protecting Genesys interests and balancing business objectives, employee experience, technical performance, cost, schedule, quality, risk, and long\-term operational value.
* Develop and manage scopes, schedules, budgets, forecasts, procurement plans, change controls, risk registers, governance, reporting, and escalation paths; identify issues early and drive corrective action.
* Coordinate architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, vendors, landlords, and internal stakeholders across regions and time zones, and support site selection and technical due diligence.

**Technical Facilities Leadership**

jobs.title: Salesforce Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**


Founded in 2005, Pierce Washington helps clients transform their quote\-to\-cash process. We are creating a next\-generation Total Commerce Company and will own the Total Commerce category – a fast growing segment in the tech industry. This is the place to come to if you want to work with the best, get in at the ground floor and help sustain and grow one of the best places to work. We have completed over 100 CPQ projects enabling leading enterprise companies to achieve their most complex Q2C process automation goals and transform how they do business.


Leveraging this expertise, our Salesforce Practice is focused on delivering Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions to clients in the High Tech and Manufacturing industries. Come join a growing Salesforce Practice and work on fun projects with good people!

**Who are you?**


You are an experienced Salesforce Project Manager, who has experience managing enterprise level projects. You enjoy being a hands\-on business analyst while managing complex projects and delivering excellence for your clients. As the client’s main point of contact, you will establish a comprehensive understanding of project expectations and business processes and manage a plan to meet these goals.


You strive for and deliver excellence for yourself, your team, and your clients. You have a natural curiosity to uncover a client’s pain points, key requirements and implicit needs, provide day\-to\-day leadership and timely project status updates to our clients, and work closely with Pierce Washington and client technical and non\-technical team members to complete projects on\-time and within budget. This will be a 100% remote postion.

**What you get to do:**

* Working closely with the Solution Architect, you will create and execute project work plans and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements
* In this capacity, you will lead, or co\-lead with the Solution Architect, completion of the following business analyst functions:
	+ discovery workshops to gather, define, and document current and future state business processes and functional requirements
	+ document requirements in the form of process flow diagrams and user stories
	+ develop implementation estimates and plans for phases of the delivery lifecycle, including configuration, development, testing, training, communications, deployment, and post go\-live support
	+ design user story test scripts and participate in end\-user acceptance testing
* Manage the day\-to\-day operational aspects of the project and scope, the overall client relationship and demonstrate respect and responsiveness to client needs
* Cultivate and manage highly functional teams comprised of Solution Architects, Consultants and Developers and client resources through all phases of an Agile Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to define and validate the technical approach, strategy and deliverables for the project
* Manage project deliverables, financials and schedule to ensure the project stays on track and drive implementation of the solution
* Monitor project status and assess risk in process, people and/or technology and adjust project plans to address accordingly
* Perform impact analysis for scope change requests and document changes to requirements
* Serve as an expert in Agile methodology to effectively apply our delivery methodology and enforce project standards
* Ensure successful completion of project deliverables, cost, and timelines
* Maintain a sense of ownership as it pertains to client satisfaction, company profitability and project team resource workload
* Provide clear and effective communication on risks, scope changes and an understanding of change management techniques and processes

**What you bring to the role:**


4\+ years of Salesforce industry experience in a consulting capacity as a Business Analyst and/or Project Manager working with the Sales Could and/or Service Cloud * \- **must have experience managing enterprise level projects**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience managing E**nterprise Salesforce CPQ** projects that were at least 6 months in duration and included data migrations and integrations with ERP systems
* Experience with Salesforce org consolidation/migration projects a bonus
* Proven expert in Agile SDLC project management theories, practices and methods
* Ability to serve as a liaison between both business and technical teams to drive effective, timely solutions that fulfill both strategic and operational needs
* Experienced in executing gap analysis and requirements traceability matrices
* Excellent client\-facing written and oral communication skills
* Ability to pivot and adapt in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to challenge, innovate, lead and drive projects to close
* Experienced with Visio, Jira, Confluence, Prodly, Copado, or similar tools desirable
* Experience in the High Tech or Manufacturing industries highly desired
* PMP certification is preferred
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire within first several months
* Preferred Salesforce certifications: Administrator
* Experience in High Tech or Manufacturing industries highly desired
* Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science or information systems

**What we’ll do for you:**

* Competitive compensation package
* Health, vision, dental, life \& disability insurance
* Flexible, collaborative work environment with a commitment to work life balance
* Work anywhere, with full remote and hybrid options depending on location
* Learn and challenge yourself in a fast\-paced, growing tech company

**More about us:**


Since 2005, Pierce Washington has helped enterprises transform their quote\-to\-cash process in four ways: we implement CPQ, eCommerce and Billing \& Subscription Management solutions and we integrate those solutions to ERP and other enterprise systems. By focusing on these four areas – and doing them well – we have built our reputation

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for **two** Business Analysts to join our team!

**About Perfected**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


When corporations cause harm, someone has to answer for it. At Perfected, we guide people through complex legal journeys with one clear goal: to hold corporations accountable and help communities reclaim their power.


We start with people—their stories, their pain, their hope—and we stand with them every step of the way. Our work is rooted in transparency, empathy, and advocacy. We partner with law firms across the country to bring clarity to chaos, amplify community voices, and create human\-centered experiences that make justice feel within reach.

**Location Note**


These are remote\-based positions and all work must be performed in a state in which Strategic Campaign Sourcing LLC is registered to do business (AL, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, IL, KY, LA, MA, ME, MI, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VI, VA, WI). Our preference is for applicants located \- or willing and able to work \- in the Pacific or Mountain time zones.

 **About the Role**


The **Business Analyst** will support the operational efficiency, data quality, and reporting needs of our Client Operations and Business Operations teams. This role is ideal for someone who is detail\-oriented, highly organized, and eager to build a strong foundation in operations, analytics, and process improvement.


As a Business Analyst, you’ll play a critical role in maintaining daily operational reporting, supporting data ingestion and quality control, tracking production and capacity metrics, and assisting with process documentation. You’ll work closely with Senior Program Leads, Program Leads, and cross\-functional partners to ensure teams have accurate data, clear processes, and reliable insights to support decision\-making.


This role provides hands\-on exposure to operational workflows, reporting systems, and continuous improvement initiatives, with a clear growth path into Program Lead and Senior Program Lead roles over time.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Prepare and distribute daily, weekly, and ad hoc operational reports for internal stakeholders.
* Support regular data uploads and track successful ingestion into key systems.
* Perform quality control (QC) checks on operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Identify data discrepancies and escalate issues for resolution.
* Maintain and update production tracking tools and capacity planning trackers.
* Support workload analysis and resource utilization reporting.
* Assist in identifying trends or potential risks related to volume, capacity, or throughput.
* Compile, maintain, and manage client communication distribution lists to support accurate outreach.
* Ensure lists and datasets are up to date and aligned with current operational requirements.
* Support coordination across teams by providing timely and accurate data inputs.
* Assist in drafting, updating, and maintaining SOPs, process documentation, and reference materials.
* Contribute to process standardization efforts across programs.
* Support implementation of updated workflows by ensuring documentation remains current
* Assist in building dashboards and operational insights to support leadership decision\-making.
* Collaborate with Program Leads and Senior Program Leads on improvement initiatives.
* Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and performance development conversations.
* Take on additional analytical or operational support tasks as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.
* 1\+ years of experience in operations, reporting, data support, or administrative roles.
* Experience in legal, healthcare, or client services environments is a plus.
* Familiarity with reporting systems, CRMs, or project management tools is helpful but not required.
* Comfort working with large datasets and repetitive tasks while maintaining accuracy.
* Proficiency in Excel (PivotTables, VLOOKUPs, formulas).

**Skills \& Abilities**
-----------------------

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
* Willingness to learn, ask questions, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.
* Adaptability in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Frequent need for oral, written, and auditory communication.
* Ability to sit for long periods of time.
* Prolonged periods working on a computer.
* Frequent repetitive hand and wrist motions.
* Excellent near vision to see details on a computer screen, including color differentiation.
* Ability to work in a fast paced and sometimes stressful services environment.
* Occasional need for travel.

**Benefits at a Glance**
------------------------

* **Time Off:** PTO (15 days, earned on an accrual basis; increases at 3rd and 5th anniversary), sick leave (10 days, earned on an accrual basis), paid holidays (14\) and floating holidays (2 days).
* **Health \& Wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

We appreciate your interest in employment with The Honest Company! The Honest Company is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity, and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally\-recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. Applicants with disabilities who need assistance with the application process may be entitled to a reasonable accommodation in accordance with applicable law. If you need assistance in completing this application or with the application process because of a disability, please contact the Human Resources Department at 1\.888\.862\.8818 or 1\.310\.857\.3020\.


**About Us**



The Honest Company (NASDAQ: HNST) is a personal care company dedicated to creating cleanly\-formulated and sustainably\-designed products spanning categories across diapers, wipes, baby personal care, beauty, apparel, household care and wellness. Launched in 2012, the Company is on a mission to challenge ingredients, ideals, and industries through the power of the Honest brand, the Honest team, and the Honest Standard. For more information about the Honest Standard and the Company, please visit www.honest.com.


**Our Mission**



We're on a mission to empower people to live happy, healthy lives. We're a wellness brand with values rooted in consciousness, community, transparency, and design. Every day and in every way, we hold ourselves to an Honest standard. We believe that it is our responsibility to do our part to help create a healthy and sustainable future for all.


**The Role**



The Honest Company is looking for a **Temporary Data Analyst** to support our Consumer Insights and Category Management teams in the development and maintenance of Circana Custom Models. This is a part\-time temporary engagement of **20 hours per week and is expected to run for approximately 2–3 months**, or until the assigned coding project is substantially complete.



In this role, you will review and code individual product and business lines into the appropriate category, subcategory, segment, and attribution structures. You'll apply established business rules and category definitions consistently across a high volume of data, research products and brands as needed, and identify items that require additional business context or clarification.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys structured analytical work, has exceptional attention to detail, and can work independently while knowing when to escalate questions or decisions to the appropriate internal team.


**What You'll Do:**


* Review and code individual Circana product and business lines into the appropriate category, subcategory, segment, and attribution hierarchy.
* Apply established business definitions, coding rules, and classification logic consistently across large volumes of data.
* Research products, brands, and business information as needed to determine the appropriate classification.
* Identify and flag ambiguous or unclear items for internal review rather than making unsupported assumptions.
* Incorporate category, brand, and portfolio context provided by the Consumer Insights and Category Management teams into coding decisions.
* Conduct quality checks to identify missing, inconsistent, duplicate, or incorrectly coded records.
* Review completed coding to ensure consistency across brands, products, categories, and attribution structures.
* Clearly document questions, assumptions, decisions, and items requiring additional guidance.
* Incorporate feedback and updates to coding methodology throughout the project. Manage weekly project priorities and maintain consistent progress toward project completion.


**What You'll Need:**


* 1\+ years of experience working with data, analytics, data entry, category management, consumer insights, or a related field preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to work accurately with large volumes of data and repetitive line\-level tasks.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to sort, filter, organize, and manipulate large datasets.
* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies or anomalies.
* Ability to understand and consistently apply business rules, classification logic, and established guidelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to document questions, assumptions, and decisions clearly.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and escalating items that require additional business judgment.


**Nice to Have:**


* Experience with Circana/IRI, NielsenIQ, Numerator, or other CPG syndicated data.
* Experience within CPG, particularly in Category Management, Sales, Analytics, or Consumer Insights.
* Familiarity with product hierarchies, category taxonomies, brand portfolios, or syndicated market data.
* Experience building or maintaining custom datasets, hierarchies, taxonomies, or classification systems.
* Experience with data quality or data governance processes.
* Exposure to Power BI, SQL, or other analytical tools.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.


**You'll Love This Job If You're:**


* Extremely detail\-oriented. You naturally catch small inconsistencies and take pride in accurate, high\-quality work.
* Curious. You're willing to research a product, brand, or category to understand where it belongs.
* Consistent. You can apply the same logic and business rules across thousands of records.
* Pragmatic. You know when you can make a decision independently and when additional business context is needed.
* Collaborative. You're receptive to feedback and can quickly incorporate changes to coding logic and project direction.


**Compensation**



The pay range for this role is $31\.73\-$

jobs.title: Principal Business Analyst, Growth
jobs.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting\-edge technology, we're enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?



We're looking for a Principal Business Analyst to shape how new customers find Mission Lane, reporting to the Director, Growth.


**The impact you'll make:**



Getting approved for a credit card is often someone's first step toward building credit, and that can put a car, a home, or whatever's next within their reach. As Principal Business Analyst, Growth, you decide where and how we spend so more people find Mission Lane when they are ready for that next step. You'll manage test investments at a meaningful scale, weighing the credit risk on each one, and you'll run the day\-to\-day strategy and relationship with one of our biggest affiliate partners.



Mission Lane is still young, but we've landed in an exciting, stable stretch of maturation. We're still building but we've already got a solid foundation. There's never been a better time to learn and grow right along with us.


**As Principal Business Analyst, Growth you will:**


* Design and size acquisition tests, whether that's a new channel, a new customer segment, or a new offer, and make the call on how big a swing is worth taking
* Analyze the credit risk on a test before it launches: what the downside looks like if it underperforms, and whether that downside is one we can live with while we learn, reviewing the biggest bets with your manager before they go
* Own the day\-to\-day operations of third party relationships.
* Work with acquisition partners to keep those channels performing, from placement and pricing to the data terms behind them
* Track a test's performance while it's live, so you catch one running hot on risk or cold on response before it burns through its budget
* Partner cross\-functionally with engineering and product and marketing as you launch tests with net\-new products or capabilities. i
* Share your strategy and results directly with senior leadership


**You'll thrive in this role if:**


* You've spent time in financial services, so weighing credit risk, compliance, and regulatory considerations into a decision isn't new territory for you
* You're comfortable being accountable for real money: you can make the case for a test's exposure as confidently as you can make the case for its upside
* You're curious enough to dig into the reasoning behind your own analysis, down to the assumptions it's built on, so you understand it at an elemental level
* You take ownership of your work end to end, catching your own mistakes before they compound
* You can explain a business problem clearly enough that someone outside your immediate team could follow your thinking


**Minimum qualifications:**


* 2\+ years of experience in a highly analytical role
* Financial Services Industry experience
* A bachelor's or master's degree in economics, finance, engineering, mathematics, or a similarly quantitative field, with a strong academic record

* Drive continuous improvement across operating processes, reporting, controls governance, issue management, and execution routines to improve transparency, efficiency, and follow\-through.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Credit & Lending
jobs.description:
Mercury is building Mercury Bank, N.A., a proposed nationally chartered bank focused on serving ambitious businesses. Credit and lending are central to that mission, and as we migrate our charge card and term loan products to the Bank's own balance sheet and build the next generation of lending infrastructure, we need someone who can hold the full program together.



The Senior Technical Program Manager for Credit and Lending will own end\-to\-end delivery of the technology programs that power Mercury's charge card, term loan, and adjacent credit products. You will be the connective tissue between Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Operations: setting strategy for how these programs run, surfacing tradeoffs that unblock leaders, sequencing the critical path, and ensuring that what ships is audit\-ready from day one.



We are looking for someone who has operated at this level before, in a regulated environment, at scale, with real accountability for outcomes.


* *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC\-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*


### **What you'll do:**


#### **Program ownership**


* Own the integrated program plan across all active credit and lending workstreams, covering milestones, dependencies, and critical paths across Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Operations.
* Proactively manage sequencing, resourcing tradeoffs, and escalations. When initiatives are off\-track, you identify it first and bring a recommended path forward.
* Ensure Compliance, Treasury, and Operations readiness lands alongside product and regulatory milestones
* Drive incident learnings back into design, test coverage, and runbooks so each issue improves the underlying system, not just fixes the symptom.
* Contribute to the overall (proposed) Mercury Bank, NA technical program, collaborating with other TPMs to build a holistic view of progress and risks

#### **Governance and decision\-making**


* Keep a single source of truth for status, decisions, risks, and owners. Maintain a living RAID log with clear owners and impact assessments.
* Facilitate structured decision\-making by surfacing options and tradeoffs to leaders before problems escalate.
* Build and improve the operating systems that drive credit and lending product decisions: planning cycles, reviews, decision frameworks, launch readiness.

#### **Communication and influence**


* Produce concise, predictable updates calibrated to the audience.
* Synthesize complex cross\-functional information into recommendations that help executives decide and move.
* Produce documentation of program objectives, architecture decisions, and operational impacts that onboards new team members without requiring a meeting to explain it.
* Function as a trusted thought partner to engineering leads, product managers, and senior leadership.

#### **Execution and improvement**


* Identify inefficiencies and eliminate them through automation, AI tooling, or process redesign.
* Lead technical retrospectives and post\-mortems, ensuring learnings are systematized rather than forgotten.

### **What we're looking for:**


#### **Experience**


* 10\+ years of program management or technical program management in a high\-growth or regulated environment.
* Direct experience in financial services, fintech, or credit infrastructure. Compliance, audit, reporting and risk management obligations are familiar territory.
* Track record of operating at the department or business level, owning programs with multiple concurrent workstreams and cross\-functional accountability.
* Proven ability to communicate with and influence executive stakeholders, in writing and in high\-stakes meetings, without a senior manager to translate.
* Bonus: Familiarity with the lending tooling ecosystem such as loan origination, credit risk management and lending management systems.

#### **How you work**


* Product\-first. You evaluate everything through: what is the user problem, what is the fastest path to learning, what actually moves the needle.
* AI\-native. You use AI tools to do your actual work. You have built workflows or tooling that changed how your team operates. When you see a repetitive process, you automate it.
* Comfortable in ambiguity. You build structure where there is none.
* Systems thinker. You see dependencies, second\-order effects, and points of failure before they surface, and you build programs that account for them.
* Energized by building and operating. You do your best work designing the system and running it well once it is built.

### **What you bring:**


* Technical fluency. You can understand and challenge engineering decisions, identify technical risks early, and translate complexity for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You write documentation that clarifies hard decisions and build frameworks teams actually adopt.
* Commercial instincts. You understand the financial dynamics of a lending business well enough to evaluate tradeoffs with authority.
* High emotional intelligence. You build trust quickly across engineering, product, risk, and executive stakeholders. You navigate complex interpersonal situations without losing credibility or momentum.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Program Manager
jobs.description:
Securitas Security Services USA, Inc. is a global leader in protective services, delivering specialized guarding, advanced technology solutions, and comprehensive risk management to clients across diverse industries. Our mission is clear: *to help make your world a safer place*. With a strong legacy of trust, innovation, and global expertise, we design and deliver tailored security programs that combine cutting\-edge technology with exceptional service.

 **Position: Senior Regional Program Manager – Security**  

**Location: Onsite at client facility, Manhattan, NY**

  

The Senior Regional Program Manager (SRPM) is the client’s primary Security Advisor and strategic partner, responsible for the overall security program across the assigned regional portfolio. This role owns the account strategy end\-to\-end, leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of a comprehensive security program that aligns Securitas and client objectives.

  

The SRPM drives program performance, profitability, and consistency across all locations, ensuring a scalable and sustainable security posture. A core focus is proactive risk management, identifying issues early, implementing forward\-looking recommendations, and preventing recurrence through robust processes, standards, and controls.

**Compensation and Benefits**


Securitas offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package. Based on experience, the starting salary range for this role is **$150,000–$156,000**, plus a full benefits program that includes:

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 10 accrued vacation days, 4 floating holidays, and 6 sick days
* Monthly parking provided
* Bonus eligible

**Core Responsibilities**


The Senior Regional Program Manager leads and/or directly completes tasks in the following areas:

* **Client Relationship \& Program Leadership**
	+ Serve as the key point of contact and trusted Security Advisor for the client.
	+ Drive continuous improvement and evolution of the regional security program, ensuring alignment with client risk appetite and business priorities.
* **P\&L Ownership \& Performance Management**
	+ Maintain full profit and loss (P\&L) responsibility for the assigned account.
	+ Analyze operational and financial indicators to optimize performance, efficiency, and value delivery.
* **Executive Coordination \& Service Quality**
	+ Coordinate account activity and regularly brief the Global Clients Americas (GCA) Vice President.
	+ Implement programs and initiatives, monitor service quality, and initiate timely corrective actions where needed.
* **Security Risk Reviews \& Safety Programs**
	+ Lead and perform Security Risk Reviews of client facilities using industry best practices and client\-specific assessment tools.
	+ Implement and manage global safety programs; coordinate with the client to support special events, incidents, and emergency coverage.
* **Branch Alignment \& Customer Service Excellence**
	+ Ensure branches maintain a consistent focus on high\-quality customer service and risk\-aware operations.
	+ Provide guidance to support retention and growth of profitable business.
* **Staffing Strategy \& Workforce Management**
	+ Ensure appropriate staffing levels in collaboration with area management.
	+ Oversee scheduling to meet client requirements while controlling labor costs.
	+ Build strong teams, foster collaboration, and lead the implementation of progressive changes.
* **Governance, Transitions \& Contract Compliance**
	+ Conduct regular account reviews with client and Securitas leadership.
	+ Address actual and potential issues, support RFP responses, and lead security planning, assessments, and surveys.
	+ Coordinate review and updates of global and local post orders; ensure contract compliance across the entire portfolio.
* **Strategic Budgeting \& Investment Planning**
	+ Partner with the client on strategic budget preparation for guard services and security system deployments.
	+ Align investments with risk priorities and long\-term program objectives.
* **Global Security Strategy \& Feasibility**
	+ Lead the client in evaluating global security needs and determining feasibility of requested services.
	+ Demonstrate the ability to operate effectively in a complex, global business environment.
* **Global Service Network \& Best Practices**
	+ Develop and manage a global service network for client locations, building strong relationships with Securitas entities and alliance partners.
	+ Coordinate, monitor, and evaluate global service delivery; develop and apply global best practices using the GCA model.
* **Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**
	+ Identify opportunities to enhance working practices, products, and technologies.
	+ Set clear goals, use data\-driven analysis and decision\-making, and take initiative to resolve current and potential problems with sustainable solutions.

**Qualifications**


To succeed in this Senior Regional Program Manager role, you should have:

* Bachelor’s degree and at least **10 years of management experience**, preferably in security, hospitality, retail, or service industries.
* Demonstrated competencies in **financial management, leadership, and business administration**.
* Proven track record in **strategic thinking, operational analysis, and innovative problem\-solving**.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead diverse teams and manage complex, multi\-site projects.
* Ability to travel frequently within **Canada and the United States** and manage sensitive, confidential information with discretion.

**Key Competencies**

* In\-depth knowledge of security operations, procedures, and risk management practices.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and prioritization skills.
* Robust financial acumen, including P\&L management.
* Ability to interpret, track, and maintain schedules, metrics, and performance indicators.

The Product Risk Program Manager will join the Assurance Assessments within the Product Risk Program Manager team. This role is responsible for assessing risk determinations for their accuracy. More specifically, this role will be responsible for ensuring that approved privacy decisions include all relevant risks and related mitigations. Additionally, the PRPM in this role will help ensure that required mitigations are appropriately implemented. In conducting these reviews and any needed remediations, PRPMs will engage key internal stakeholders including product, engineering, legal, and risk subject matter experts. PRPMs may also need to engage external stakeholders such as an auditor or assessor. A strong candidate for this role will have experience with compliance programs and auditing processes and be able to navigate ambiguity by defining structure, clarifying priorities, and driving progress without complete information.  

  

  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Establish expertise across a system that’s focused on reviewing and mitigating product risks
* Establish risk expertise across multiple areas including privacy and integrity
* Identify gaps in risk assessments and determinations made by product stakeholders
* Engage cross functional partners and teams including product as needed to finalize assessments about risk determinations
* Able to explain and rationalize compliance and risk decisions to external stakeholders including auditors and assessors
* Track and provide any needed documentation that stems from remediation workflows
* Provide feedback to tooling and platform stakeholders aimed at improving the accuracy and efficiency of the system’s outcomes
* Minimum Qualifications:
* 3\+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust \& safety, privacy, or legal/compliance environments

* 2\+ years of experience in risk management, program management, compliance, trust and safety, or a related field within a technology or product organization
* Experience conducting structured risk assessments and translating findings into actionable recommendations for product or business stakeholders
* Experience managing cross\-functional programs, including coordinating across legal, policy, engineering, and operations teams to drive alignment and resolution
* Experience developing and maintaining program documentation such as risk registers, playbooks, decision frameworks, or process runbooks
* Experience communicating complex risk topics in writing to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including leadership\-level stakeholders

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with product risk, trust and safety, or regulatory compliance programs at a large\-scale consumer technology or social media company
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ability to build and iterate on risk frameworks or governance processes in ambiguous, fast\-moving product environments
* Experience using data analysis or workflow automation tools to monitor risk signals, track mitigation progress, or improve program efficiency

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon spent decades building one of the best supply chains in the world to run its own business, moving, storing, and delivering products fast and reliably. Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) now opens that same network up to other businesses, so any company can use Amazon's multimodal ground and air freight, warehousing, distribution \& fulfillment, and parcel shipping to run their own operations. Think of it like what AWS did for cloud computing, but for supply chain, and it is just getting started.
  

  

We're looking for a Senior Business Analyst to turn ASCS's data into decisions – you don't just report what happened — you crisply explain why it happened, what it means for the business, and what we should do differently tomorrow. You'll dig into complex, messy datasets, build the dashboards and pipelines that make performance visible, and deliver the insight that changes what leadership prioritizes next. The role spans strategic and tactical work — from defining the analytical framework to writing the query yourself. It's highly visible, cross\-functional, and not for someone who wants a narrow lane.  

  

The ideal candidate will be a sharp SQL and BI practitioner who builds things that scale, translates ambiguity into structure, and transforms data into narratives that drive action. You are comfortable embracing ambiguity, translating multi\-channel performance data into a clear narrative, and changing a stakeholder's mind with evidence rather than opinion. You work backward from the customer, you dive deep rather than accepting the first plausible explanation, and you'd rather build a scalable solution once than answer the same ad hoc question five times.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Turn operational and performance data into insights and narratives leadership can act on — not just charts, the "so what."
* Work with large, complex, sometimes\-ugly datasets using the right tool for the job, whether that's SQL, Python, or a spreadsheet.
* Partner with Product, Program, Engineering, and Sales to define data requirements and build BI solutions that actually get used, not just launched.
* Build and own self\-serve analytics — dashboards, drill\-downs, alerts, and metric definitions — so performance is obvious at a glance across ASCS service lines.
* Define measurement frameworks that connect acquisition, engagement, and operational KPIs, and run retrospectives that end in specific optimization actions, not just observations.
* Identify what's actually driving key metrics, quantify the impact, and make the call on where the business should invest next.
* Build automated pipelines and reporting that cut manual effort and speed up decisions.
* Mentor junior analysts on technique, problem\-solving, and how to land a recommendation with a room full of stakeholders.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of writing SQL queries and creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Power BI experience
* 7\+ years of business or financial analysis, product costing, procurement, or a quantitative role experience
* 5\+ years of Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) experience
* Experience applying basic statistical methods (e.g. regression) to difficult business problems
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA
* Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
* Interest in exploring how automation and AI can power workflows, dashboards, and campaigns
