jobs.title: Logistics Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**

This isn't a desk job; it's a front\-row seat to shaping how the U.S. military postures, moves, and sustains forces across the Pacific theater. As a Logistics Operations Analyst at Camp Smith, you'll translate complex engineering requirements and operational priorities into decisions that matter, delivering planning products and assessments directly to senior military and civilian leaders. You'll work at the intersection of joint logistics, engineering operations, and theater\-level planning, where your analysis drives real outcomes across a vast and contested region. If you thrive in high\-stakes environments and want your work to count, this is where you belong.

**THE MISSION**

The Pacific theater demands precision, adaptability, and deep operational know\-how. K2 is looking for a Logistics Operations Analyst to support a joint logistics and engineering organization at Camp Smith, Honolulu, HI. You'll analyze theater requirements, infrastructure constraints, and logistics dependencies, then turn that analysis into actionable products for decision\-makers. From deliberate planning to real\-world contingency operations, your work directly supports theater readiness, force posture, and engineering integration across Service components and regional partners.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Analyze theater requirements, infrastructure constraints, access limitations, and logistics dependencies affecting engineering support across the Pacific
* Attend operational briefs, OPGs, planning sessions, and coordination meetings — independently capture decisions, taskings, risks, and follow\-up actions
* Translate engineering guidance and operational priorities into concise planning inputs, logistics assessments, staff products, and recommendations
* Coordinate with engineering, logistics, planning, and operations personnel across the joint force and Service components
* Support integration of engineering requirements into CONPLANs, OPLANs, contingency plans, exercise plans, and related operational products
* Assess the feasibility and supportability of force posture, basing, infrastructure, and sustainment concepts
* Develop briefings, decision papers, executive summaries, readiness updates, trackers, and other products for senior military and civilian leaders
* Support exercise operations and real\-world planning activities, including participation in a shift\-work environment when required
* Maintain planning processes, status trackers, readiness indicators, and reporting mechanisms that improve visibility of engineering and logistics requirements
* Provide lessons learned and post\-event recommendations to improve future planning and operational execution
* Plan, track, and coordinate movement of Class IV materials — sandbags, barbed wire, lumber, concrete, and comparable construction and barrier materials — through TRANSCOM, DLA, military distribution, or similar logistics channels
* Translate engineering requirements, including BDA, ADR, PDR, and FP considerations, into prioritized logistics assessments, movement actions, and clear operational briefings

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, logistics, operations research, architecture, military studies, national security studies, regional planning, or a related field
* Eight or more years of relevant experience in joint military planning, operational logistics, engineering operations, infrastructure assessment, force posture analysis, or defense planning support
* Demonstrated experience supporting DoD, Combatant Command, Service component, defense agency, or comparable military planning environments
* Working knowledge of joint planning processes, operational design, plan assessment, and staff integration across deliberate and crisis action planning
* Strong analytical and note\-taking skills, including the ability to understand construction properties and communicate technically accurate information to the broader team
* Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, particularly when attending briefs, OPGs, and other senior\-level planning forums
* Solid understanding of Pacific geography, regional access constraints, and the operating environment involving U.S. allies and partners
* Familiarity with joint operations, Priority of Effort, and the integration of engineering support across Service components
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders and coordinate across diverse stakeholder groups
* Ability to work effectively in an exercise, contingency, or shift\-work environment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and common planning, collaboration, tracking, and data\-analysis tools
* Active TS/SCI eligibility

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Prior experience supporting U.S. Pacific Command, another Geographic Combatant Command, Joint Staff, Service component headquarters, or comparable theater\-level organization
* Experience with contingency engineering, crisis action teams, exercise planning cells, posture planning, infrastructure assessments, or theater logistics planning
* Experience working with allies, partners, host\-nation organizations, or interagency stakeholders in the Pacific region
* Joint Professional Military Education, engineer officer advanced schooling, or equivalent military planning education
* Professional Engineer license, project or program management credential, or process\-improvement certification
* Master's degree in engineering, logistics, operations research, systems engineering, national security affairs, public policy, or a related discipline

**WHY K2**

K2 is not a typical government contractor. We're an SBA 8(a) Native Hawaiian Organization built on a foundation of service, excellence, and mission focus. We put high\-performers in roles that demand their best, and we back them up with the resources, leadership, and culture to succeed. Our teams work on missions that shape national security outcomes. jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

  

Leidos has a current job opportunity for a Cyber Security Analyst on the DISA GSMO\-II program in the Washington DC Area.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  

This position provides 24x7 cybersecurity monitoring and analysis services for Department of Defense networks above the SECRET level. This includes performing real\-time cyber threat intelligence analysis, correlating actionable security events, performing network traffic analysis using raw packet data, and participating in the coordination of resources during the incident response process.


This position is fully on\-site in Arlington, VA. Shifts include Days (morning), Swings (evening) and Mids (night), and may require weekend and/or holiday hours. Shift availability will vary based on program needs and staffing levels. All new hires’ initial 4\-6 weeks will be spent on weekday Day Shift to complete onboarding, training and familiarization. Applicants must remain flexible to potential shift modifications to assist in meeting minimum staffing requirements.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Review DoD and open\-source intelligence for threats and to identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and integrate those into sensors and SIEMs
* Utilize alerts from endpoints, IDS/IPS, netflow, and custom sensors to identify compromises on customer networks/endpoints
* Review massive log files, pivot between data sets, and correlate evidence for incident investigations
* Triage alerts to identify malicious actors on customer networks
* Report incidents to customers and USCYBERCOM
* Develop, deploy, and maintain custom analytics and countermeasures

 **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Must have an active DoD Top Secret security w/ SCI clearance eligibility.
* Bachelor's Degree and 4\+ years of prior relevant experience; additional work experience or Cyber courses/certifications may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
* Demonstrated understanding of TCP/IP, common networking ports and protocols, traffic flow, system administration, OSI model, defense\-in\-depth and common security elements.
* Motivated self\-starter with strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to create complex technical reports on analytic findings
* DoD 8570 IAT level II or higher certification such as CompTIA Security\+ CE, ISC2 SSCP, SANS GSEC prior to starting.
* DoD 8570 CSSP\-A level Certification such as CEH, CySA\+, GCIA or other certification is required within 180 days of hire.
* Demonstrated commitment to training, self\-study and maintaining proficiency in the technical cyber security domain and an ability to think and work independently
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Willing to perform shift work
* Must be a US Citizen

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* CND experience (Protect, Detect, Respond and Sustain) within a Computer Incident Response organization.
* Demonstrated understanding of the life cycle of network threats, attacks, attack vectors and methods of exploitation with an understanding of intrusion set tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs).
* Advanced understanding of TCP/IP, common networking ports and protocols, traffic flow, system administration, OSI model, defense\-in\-depth and common security elements.
* Experience with development and incorporation of AI and automation tools into Incident Response processes.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience analyzing high volumes of logs, network data (e.g. Splunk, Suricata, Zeek, Full Packet Capture), and other attack artifacts in support of incident investigations.
* In\-depth knowledge of architecture, engineering, and operations of at least one enterprise SIEM platform (e.g. Splunk ES, Elastic).
* Experience and proficiency with any of the following: Splunk, Suricata, Zeek, Full Packet Capture, Network Forensics, Endpoint Detection and Response, Corelight, Elastic.
* Experience with malware analysis concepts and methods.
* Unix/Linux command line experience.
* Scripting and or programming experience to write Suricata and Zeek rule sets.
* Familiarity or experience in Intelligence Driven Defense and/or Mitre ATT\&CK, and/or Cyber Kill Chain methodologies.

Top\-tier candidates will deliver expert intelligence analysis to enable end\-to\-end capability development—translating intelligence insights into actionable inputs that drive system design, experimentation, and operational transition. This position will serve as a critical interface between the intelligence community (IC), Department of War (DoW), and the R\&D customer, ensuring continuous integration of threat\-informed analysis across the full capability lifecycle.

  



Ideal candidates bring deep expertise in analyzing SAP technologies, interpreting complex intelligence reporting, and understanding national security\-related science and technology. Successful candidates demonstrate a strong capacity to rapidly learn new topics and identify threats to U.S. national security systems. Prior experience in the Department of Defense/War and/or Intelligence Community (IC) is essential.

* Bachelor’s degree in intelligence, national security studies, engineering, physics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.description:

Koniag Data Solutions, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a SCIF Management/Senior Security Manager with a TS/SCI security clearance to support KDS and our government customer at the Pentagon, Arlington, VA.

Essential Functions, Responsibilities \& Duties may include, but are not limited to:
  
  

**Operations:**  

* Develop and maintain operations and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure continuity in support.
* Provide subject matter expertise regarding physical security equipment capabilities, implementation, and deployment to support DoD Physical Security Programs, ensuring the protection of critical resources, facilities, and personnel.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments to identify physical security weaknesses, and draft, coordinate, and update security policies and procedures to mitigate identified deficiencies.
* Analyze, recommend, and apply cost\-effective threat\-justified physical security countermeasures and develop tracking mechanisms to eliminate unnecessary security expenditures or operational impediments.
* Deliver written assessments and actionable recommendations to optimize the efficiency of Component implementations, incorporating innovative interagency or industry\-standard approaches.
* Provide strategic support and develop formal documentation (e.g., briefing slides, position papers) to assist the SCIF Government Lead in establishing physical security policies, procedures, and resource allocations.
* Assist the DOT\&E Government Lead in drafting, coordinating, and implanting policies and procedures across security disciplines, including Information, Personnel, Industrial, SCI, and SAP Programs.


**Personnel Security:**  

* Maintain familiarity with personnel security standards of Intelligence Community Directive (ICD)\-704 and Intelligence Community Program Guidelines (ICPG's) 704\.1 and 704\.5\.
* Maintain familiarity with DoD Information Security Program and Protection of Sensitive Compartmented Information guidelines in DoDM 5200\.01 Vols.1\-4
* Liaise with the Air Force Office of Special Investigations (AFOSI) Eagle Eyes and WHS foreign travel to provide personnel with the requisite threat briefings prior to foreign travel.
* Conduct Foreign Travel briefings and debriefings, upload into personnel JADE file.
* Liaise with government customers for the process of requesting staff SCI access.
* Liaise with Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) Special Security Office (SSO) for final eligibility determination and SCI indoctrinations for personnel.
* Coordinate and validate DISS visit requests, periodically updating SCI indoctrinated /personnel records, as required.


**Physical and Technical Security:**  

* Maintain familiarity with physical security standards for the construction and protection of Sensitive Compartmented Facilities (SCIFs) as proscribed in ICD 705 and Intelligence Community Standard (ICS) 705\-1 and 2\.
* Maintain familiarity with Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) Administration of Physical Security, Visitor Control, and Technical Security of DoDM 5105\.21, Vol 2\.
* Maintain Operations Security (OPSEC) principles critical for protecting operational activities and security of the SCIF
* Conduct and annotate entry/exit inspections to deter unauthorized removal of classified information in accordance with DoDM 5205\.07\-V\-3\.
* Review and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) annually.
* Develop new SOPs as required.


**Secure Communications:**  

* Maintain familiarity with the protection and safeguarding of COMSEC equipment, keying material, or other cryptographic material
* Conduct periodic re\-inspections, update accreditation checklist (SAPF Security Compliance Inspection Checklist)
* Experience coordinating schedules of secure equipment and spaces
* Experience operating secure VOIP and VTC units a plus


**Special Access Programs (SAPs):**  

* Maintain familiarity and conduct annual self\-inspections as prescribed in DoDM 5205\.07, V\-1 DoD Special Access Program (SAP) Security Manual
* In accordance with DoDM 5205\.07\-V\-2, familiarity with personnel security files in the Joint Access Database Environment (JADE). Maintain and update personnel security files in JADE.
* Review incumbent personnel prescreening Security Questionnaire (PSQ) as a Tier\-1 security review for program access.
* Prepare Program Access Requests (PARs) for personnel eligible for SAP access using JADE.
* Conduct special program indoctrinations for eligible personnel and establish formal debriefing program as proscribed in DoDM 5205\.07\-V\-2
* Familiarity with DoDM 5205\.07, V\-4 policy on guidance and procedures for the application of control markings on DoD SAP information.


**Safeguarding Classified Information:**  

* In accordance with DoDM 5205\.07, V1, perform duties as alternate Top Secret Control Official (TSCO)
* Conduct annual inventory of accountable classified documents and maintain in the document control accountability system.
* Serve as classified courier, as required.
* Maintaining familiarity of key concepts and principles associated with protecting CUI
* Maintaining familiarity with the guidance and reporting requirements for security incidents that involve potential or actual compromise.
* Understanding the concepts and principles associated with classification markings.
* Maintaining a system of record of all accountable SAP information/documents, and input into the approved document control accountability system in JADE.


**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree plus Six (6\) or more years of experience in physical and personnel security function

Noblis is positioned to provide technology and operational solutions to senior decision makers in the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in the Science and Technology (S\&T) Directorate. The DHS S\&T Directorate is the primary research and development arm of DHS and manages science and technology research, from development through transition, for the Department's operational components and first responders. Established by Congress to provide innovative solutions to the nation's homeland security challenges, S\&T is the core source of scientific and engineering expertise for DHS and is uniquely postured to enhance our nation's security and resilience by providing knowledge products and innovative technology solutions for the Homeland Security Enterprise (HSE).  

  

At Noblis and Noblis ESI, we have excellent teams of smart, collaborative, proactive experts and professionals. We are actively seeking to identify personnel to join our team of talented professionals who possess the experience, vision, commitment, and integrity to successfully support the S\&T mission.

The Strategic Events Analyst will provide analytical, planning, and operations support to a front office organization within the Department of Homeland Security's (DHS) Science \& Technology Directorate (S\&T). This organization is responsible for planning and executing senior\-level and strategic engagements across industry, interagency, international, Congressional, and intelligence community partners across all homeland security science and technology mission areas.  

This position will conduct end\-to\-end planning and coordination for external engagements outside the National Capital Region, analyzing and advising the proper sequencing of events to meet strategic goals. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.
  
  

**What sets us apart drives us ahead:** between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.
  
  

(Senior) IAM Business Analyst (80\-100%)
  
  

Zurich \| Working from home up to 40% possible \| Reference 8269
  
  

Would you like to shape the future of IAM across workforce identities, cloud services and AI agents? As a Senior IAM Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer, you are an IAM specialist who understands SailPoint IdentityIQ well enough to shape feasible concepts and challenge technical options, while owning stakeholder alignment, requirements and processes. You bring together business, governance, data and technology perspectives, communicate confidently with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and use data to support sound decisions. Working closely with IAM engineers, QA, operations, application owners, risk and audit, you turn emerging needs into sustainable processes and solutions. Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership and Trust guide how we work together and deliver value.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
Translate business, risk and regulatory needs into clear functional and non\-functional requirements, process models, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  
Shape and evolve IAM capabilities and governance models across workforce IAM, cloud services, non\-human identities including AI agents as well as policy\-based access control (PBAC), translating emerging needs into scalable processes and feasible solution concepts.
  
Develop solution designs for SailPoint IdentityIQ by assessing platform capabilities, defining workflows and data flows, and aligning concepts with IAM engineers and architects.
  
Analyze IAM data to identify trends, root causes, control gaps and automation opportunities, and present evidence\-based recommendations.
  
Act as the bridge between stakeholders and the distributed delivery team, supporting prioritisation, implementation, testing, rollout and adoption of sustainable IAM solutions.
  
What You Bring
  
Several years of experience as an IAM Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer or Consultant in IAM, with strong knowledge of IAM and IGA, access governance, RBAC/ABAC/PBAC, role engineering, certifications, Segregation of Duties and relevant control requirements; experience with IAM aspects of cloud services or AI agents is an advantage.
  
Practical knowledge of SailPoint IIQ/ISC and a sound understanding of systems and application architecture, including how corporate systems work together.
  
Proven experience in requirements engineering, process modelling and the software development lifecycle, with sufficient technical literacy to assess feasibility, understand implementation approaches and constructively challenge technical proposals.
  
Strong analytical and data skills, including SQL and BI tools (Python is an advantage), with the ability to turn complex information into sound decisions and clear recommendations.
  
Confident communication and facilitation skills with technical and non\-technical stakeholders in English; German is an advantage, combined with customer focus, ownership and attention to detail.
  
  

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt at \+41583998670\.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst, Global Security Intelligence
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join an innovative team that delivers tailored intelligence products and services to protect Amazon's customers and business operations. In this role, you will produce risk assessments, conduct open\-source intelligence (OSINT) investigations, and translate complex customer requirements into scalable, actionable solutions. You will leverage OSINT and analytic tradecraft to uncover emerging threats and develop strategic products that help customers anticipate risks and look around the corner.  

  

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment that demands critical thinking, deep\-dive analysis, and the ability to manage competing priorities with exceptional attention to detail. They bring a genuine passion for delighting customers, collaborating across teams, and continuously raising the bar \- always seeking opportunities to refine processes, close gaps, and deliver more impactful products.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data using advanced analytical techniques; produce written strategic analysis, oral briefs, and tactical/investigative assessments in a cohesive and concise format to serve customers across business lines.
* Proactively identify and analyze relevant threats and trends and translate findings into actionable intelligence products.
* Conduct quick\-turn and deep\-dive open\-source investigations and monitoring.
* Engage with internal and external customers to understand their priorities and translate requirements into intelligence solutions that drive security strategies.
* Support business continuity, crisis, and security management teams, including as needed outside typical work hours during security incidents and emerging crises.
* Identify new solutions, methodologies, including using AI, to help improve information collection and reporting. Including the creation of maps or other visuals and tools to support the team's deliverables.

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why Amazon Security?  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  

  

Training \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience handling confidential information
* Experience prioritizing and delivering projects on time in a fast\-moving environment
* Bachelor's degree in Intelligence Studies, International Relations, Political Science, Information Security, Criminal Justice, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* Demonstrated expertise in analytical tradecraft and methodologies, including structured analytical techniques, OSINT investigation methodologies, and threat assessment frameworks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex threat landscapes into clear, actionable intelligence for business decision\-makers.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience developing scoring methodologies and analytical frameworks that synthesize disparate data sources into decision\-ready intelligence, enabling customers to make data\-driven, risk\-informed decisions.
* Proficiency with intelligence analysis tools, OSINT platforms, data visualization software, and AI/ML\-enabled analytical capabilities.
* Master's degree in Intelligence Studies, International Security, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* OSINT certification or equivalent training
* 3\+ years in an intelligence, investigative, or analytical discipline
* Familiarity with the media and entertainment industry, including the lifecycle of a production

Apply strong project management practices, including RAID management, resource and budget planning, vendor management, dependency tracking, change management, and executive stakeholder communication.

jobs.description:
**Los Angeles or Boston (hybrid)**



RedCircle is helping creators to turn their podcast into a business. As an Analyst, you'll play an integral part in our mission as you work with our finance, product, and growth teams to make sure we have the data, systems, and processes we need in order to grow the business. This role will work end\-to\-end across our data lifecycle, split between platform work (ensuring all of our data sources are connected to the team's tools, checked for quality, and modeled to support business uses) as well as distribution work (assisting the teams with building and maintaining dashboards, analyses, and other data products for ongoing and ad hoc needs).



If you love to dig deep into the numbers, have a customer\-first mindset, and are interested in podcasting / media / influencers, this is a great gig for you. Podcasting is \*exploding\*, and this is a chance to build a career at one of the top technology startups in the space.


### **Core Responsibilities**


* Act as a "full stack" data analyst, covering data analysis, visualization, data modeling in dbt, and ETL pipeline. You're not expected to be an expert in all these areas, but you should be interested in building your skills across this range and using AI to extend your skillset.
* Bring strong curiosity to what drives our business and the patterns reflected in our data, and use your analytical skillset to provide insights and tools to support company growth in direct collaboration with our CEO and CRO.
* Update and improve our data pipeline and data models to ensure complete and accurate information is available to teammates and connected tools.
* Collaborate with product, sales, leadership, and finance team members to conduct analyses that support business growth and product decision\-making. Examples of possible projects include: funnel evaluation, sales forecasting, revenue reporting, product analytics, and marketplace analysis.

### **A great candidate has/is…**


* 4\+ years of experience in a highly analytical role, with a deep skillset in one or more data analytics area (ETL pipelines, dbt data modeling, business intelligence) and exposure to the full data stack, including SQL, dbt, Python, and data warehouses
* 3\+ years of experience collaborating with growth or product teams to address core needs, communicate with nontechnical teammates, and equip them with relevant data tools and access
* A self\-starter who is excited about learning and testing new skills and tools, including AI, to improve availability and usefulness of data across the team
* Gets jazzed about owning projects from end\-to\-end. We're a small team, so you'll be responsible for a lot and you'll need to operate autonomously
* Can work hybrid in\-person at the RedCircle office in Los Angeles or Boston 3\-4 days per week


**Compensation**



RedCircle is committed to providing competitive compensation, equity, and benefits. Compensation for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the candidate's experience, and the scope of the role, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated base salary range for this role is $75\-130k. New hire offers typically fall in the first half of the range. The higher end of the range may be considered for candidates who significantly exceed the minimum experience requirements and bring advanced skills and specialized expertise.


**About RedCircle**



RedCircle is everything a podcaster needs to run their podcast as a business. With tools for analytics, growth, payments, and advertising revenue, podcast creators use RedCircle as their command center for their podcast. RedCircle also provides a first\-of\-its\-kind podcast advertising platform, which helps brands scale ad campaigns across its thousands of podcasts in just a few clicks. As consumers, creators, and brands all flock to the podcasting medium, RedCircle is providing the picks and shovels to help all 3 groups transact.



With over 100 million monthly downloads, RedCircle is growing its community of podcasters and helping deliver millions in revenue for its creators. The company is growing quickly, is backed by some of Silicon Valley's top VCs, and is growing its team to keep up. If you want to help podcasters turn their art into income, this is the place for you.



RedCircle is an equal opportunity employer.

Sa plateforme SaaS, hautement configurable et adaptée aux spécificités du secteur, répond aux enjeux de l’univers de l’investissement alternatif. Depuis plus de 20 ans, la plateforme Dynamo™ améliore la productivité des équipes de levée de fonds, de transaction, de recherche, de services aux investisseurs, de gestion de portefeuille et de conformité dans le monde entier. Ensemble, les plus de 1 000 clients de Dynamo gèrent plus de 10 000 milliards de dollars d’actifs. Soutenue par les plus grandes sociétés de capital\-investissement au monde – Blackstone Growth et Francisco Partners – Dynamo souhaite étoffer ses équipes pour répondre à la demande croissante pour ses solutions technologiques financières.

As the largest global shared micromobility business, Lime is on a mission to build a future where transportation is shared, affordable and carbon\-free. A Time Magazine 100 Most Influential Company, Lime has powered more than one billion rides in close to 30 countries across five continents, spurring a new generation of clean alternatives to car ownership. Learn more at li.me.


Lime is hiring a Global Operations Analyst to join our Fleet Management team! Reporting to the Fleet Management leader, you will help turn operational data, stakeholder input, and recurring business needs into reliable processes and clear actions across global markets. You will work closely with Local Ops, Finance, Supply Chain, and other cross\-functional partners to maintain critical operating rhythms, improve visibility, and strengthen how Fleet Management programs scale.


This is an opportunity for an organized, analytical operator who enjoys connecting data, people, and process. You will help investigate operational issues, improve reporting quality, coordinate follow\-through, and develop practical solutions that enable teams to operate more consistently as the business evolves.


This is a remote\-first position. Candidates based in London, Paris, Lisbon or a comparable time zone are preferred to support effective collaboration across global teams. The role may require occasional in\-person support at Lime offices or warehouses and occasional travel to support business operations.

**What You'll Do:**

* Manage Reporting \& Operating Rhythms: Own the execution of established recurring reporting and operating rhythms across Fleet Management, ensuring deliverables are accurate, timely, and actionable.
* Build \& Maintain Reporting Tools: Build, maintain, and improve queries, dashboards, and recurring reports using established data sources and templates, making practical improvements and partnering on more complex changes.

Pour ce faire, nous nous appuyons sur une triple expertise :

* Gestion des risques : compliance, contrôle interne, audit interne, audit financier
* Innovation digitale : financial data analytics, data science, digital forensic
* Connaissance de la réglementation (Sapin 2, FCPA, sanctions, etc.), au service de dispositifs opérationnels

* Analyser aussi des volumes de données importants en travaillant sur les opérations et les résultats financiers de nos clients (Groupes internationaux, CAC 40, …).
* Maîtriser les différentes technologies et architectures utilisées par nos clients (ERP, bases de données, etc..) et vous adaptez, si besoin est, les moyens d’analyse des données.
* Investiguer sur des suspicions de fraudes en développant des outils agiles : collecte de données, traitement de données et data visualisation.
* Intervenir dans un contexte international lors de missions avec vos collègues d’autres pays et vous êtes parfois en relation directe avec nos clients étrangers.




**Vos compétences pour réussir :**

* Vous maîtrisez divers des langages de programmation par ex : SQL, Java, PYTHON, etc…
* Vous avez une expérience ou une appétence dans des logiciels de Dataviz tels que Tableau Software, PowerBI ou Qlik.
* Vous avez des connaissances avancées en mathématiques/statistiques.
* Vous connaissez les problématiques inhérentes aux systèmes informatiques et vous avez une appétence pour les problématiques financières et un gout pour l’investigation.




**Ce que nous recherchons :**

* Vous êtes étudiante ou étudiant au sein d’une grande école de commerce ou d’ingénieurs ou d’un cursus universitaire en gestion ou finance ;
* Vous recherchez une alternance d’une durée du 12 ou 24 mois.
* Vous faites preuve de curiosité, de dynamisme et souhaitez vous investir dans une offre de services en fort développement
* Votre rigueur et votre autonomie vous permettent d’intervenir pour gérer des problématiques métiers et informatiques dans des situations variées et complexes de différents secteurs d’activités.




**Ce que nous vous offrons :**

* Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.
* L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale.
* Une carte titre\-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75%.

**Etes\-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.**


Le processus de recrutement est composé de 3 étapes ; des tests à réaliser en ligne, ainsi qu’une ou deux rencontres avec nos managers.


Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions.

**Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.**




*EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs et collaboratrices, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients à façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires.*

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About Alma**



At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well\-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.



Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.



As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.



With 380\+ Almakers and €100M\+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!


### **About the team**



Revenue at Alma covers the entire customer lifecycle, from lead generation to churn. It brings together Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management, representing more than 100 talented professionals.



Revenue Operations plays a key role in helping these teams work together around shared goals, reliable data and efficient processes. The team supports Revenue leaders in improving performance, making better decisions and scaling the organisation.



This position is a permanent contract, based in Paris, with 2 days of remote work per week.



You will report to Basil Lizotte, and work closely with Revenue teams, the Central Data Team, Ops \& Risk, Product and Tech.


### **About the job**



As Senior Business Analyst, Revenue Operations, you will create strategic insights that help Alma's Revenue teams understand their performance, identify growth opportunities and improve their speed and efficiency.



You will work at the intersection of data, business and strategy, turning complex questions into clear recommendations and practical tools.


#### **Build reliable data foundations for Revenue**


* Build and evolve business\-facing data models by combining relevant CRM, revenue and operational data sources.
* Improve and maintain existing models and contribute to reliable end\-to\-end data pipelines.

#### **Turn business questions into strategic insights**


* Analyse Alma's target markets, market share, market dynamics and the key drivers behind commercial wins.
* Design ad hoc tools and models to help Revenue teams answer tactical business questions and make faster decisions.

#### **Improve performance monitoring and revenue growth**


* Build and manage dashboards, KPIs and revenue forecasts so teams and leadership can monitor business health and progress against their goals.
* Support Revenue leaders in setting the right targets, understanding growth dynamics and prioritising their roadmap.

#### **Drive data excellence across Revenue**


* Promote data\-informed ways of working across Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management.
* Collaborate closely with the Central Data Team to maintain high standards of data quality and consistency across the organisation.

### **You will work with**



SQL, Looker, LookML, Claude Code, Python, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Rudderstack, Segment, Salesforce


### **About you**


#### **To succeed in this job**


* You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable working with large datasets, raw CRM data and revenue\-related information, including Salesforce data.
* You have experience building business\-facing data models, dashboards, forecasts or performance analyses from the initial question through to clear recommendations.
* You can define relevant KPIs, assess business impact and communicate complex analysis in a clear and actionable way to different stakeholders.
* You have approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis or a similar role, ideally in a fast\-growing technology or fintech environment.

#### **And it will be nice if you also**


* You have experience with Looker and LookML.
* You are comfortable with Python and modern data tools such as dbt, BigQuery or GCP.
* You have worked with tracking tools such as Rudderstack or Segment, as well as experimentation methodologies such as A/B testing, significance testing and causal analysis.
* You are curious about AI\-assisted tools and are interested in using tools such as Claude Code in your daily workflow.


Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.


### **Your Alma experience**


#### **The culture**



At Alma, collective intelligence is at the heart of the way we work. We are building an international company in a fast\-growing environment, where people are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and learn from one another.



You will have access to our Learning \& Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.



We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.


#### **The role itself**



If you join Alma, you will be able to grow and have an impact by:


* Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.
* Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
* Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.

### **Compensation \& benefits**


* **Competitive salary** based on 12 months
* **Profit\-sharing and employee savings plan**
* **Health insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma, including family package
* **Disability insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma
* **Sport**: partnerships with **Gymlib** and **ClassPas

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Sr. Operations Program Manager (Sr. OPM) will work within the Device Operations group to develop the next generation of Amazon devices. The Sr. OPM will engage and work cross functionally across Engineering, Product Management, and Operations functions. The Sr. OPM will balance a mix of strategic, programmatic, and operational responsibilities to optimize new product cost, quality, and time to market. The individual is expected to work cross functionally to build consensus among the cross functional team and leadership. The individual will have experience in New Product Introduction in an Operations/Manufacturing role pertaining to Consumer Electronics (or similar) and have proven communications skills and ability to influence.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Drive product development across internal teams and external development/manufacturing partners as the Single Threaded Owner for Operations.
* Develop manufacturing and supply chain strategies to meet product requirements.
* Support product concept development as Operations lead.
* Execute development builds by overseeing technical issue resolution and production schedule.
* Regular written and verbal communication to Leadership.
* Coordinate information flow across teams in support of manufacturing/operations.
* Drive alignment of processes and initiatives throughout Device Operations organization.
* Define and guide decisions on type of Variable Engagement Module (VEM) appropriate for the specific product, customer need, and launch schedule.
* Bring in and incorporate industry best practices into the Product Operations group.
* Travel as required to accomplish business needs.

  

A day in the life  

In a typical day, a Sr. OPM performs a mix of tactical and strategic activities like deep diving to solve complex engineering and supply chain issues, and driving a Supply Chain and Operations strategy that supports the development of new products.

We are a team of self\-driven individuals with laser focus on launching innovative devices that delight our customers. We provide Operations \& Supply Chain leadership to all cross\-functional teams and work collaboratively to drive optimal product decisions.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience with end to end product delivery

jobs.title: Partner 20, Staff Security Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth\-stage technology companies, across AI, bio \+ healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B\+ under management across multiple funds.



We've established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company\-building process; we know what it's like to be in the founder's shoes. We've invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.


**The Role**
------------



We're hiring a Staff Security Technical Program Manager to run the operating system of the a16z Security team. You'll own the firm's vulnerability management program, drive cross\-team security initiatives to completion, and own the planning rhythm that keeps the team and its stakeholders aligned: sprints, OKRs, timelines, and the documentation and ticketing hygiene that make all of it real.



Security at a16z moves fast and touches every part of the firm. We work in close partnership with teams across the firm. Your job is to keep that work on schedule, keep decisions written down, and make sure nothing gets dropped between teams. Leadership should be able to get the real status from you, and engineers should see you as someone who removes obstacles, not someone who adds process.



This role requires an in\-office presence 2 days a week, Tuesday and Thursday, in our San Francisco, CA office, with occasional days in our Menlo Park, CA office.


**To join our team, you should be excited to:**
-----------------------------------------------


* Own security remediation across the firm, end to end: Pull findings from threat models, code reviews, penetration tests, vulnerability management, audits, and incident postmortems into a single tracked backlog, and manage it with clear owners, priorities, remediation SLAs
* Run the vulnerability management program: Scan coverage, patching cadence, exceptions and risk acceptance, and reporting that shows leadership where risk stands
* Work with stakeholders to keep vendor security reviews fast and consistent, and keep requesters informed on where their review stands
* Drive cross\-team security initiatives from kickoff through delivery, coordinating work across Security, IT, Legal, HR, and Compliance, and partnering with owners to keep commitments on track
* Build and run the team's execution rhythm: Sprint planning, quarterly OKRs, and ticket hygiene that keeps the work visible
* Raise the bar on documentation: Program docs, runbooks, decision records, and postmortem follow\-ups that stay findable and current
* Define and track the metrics that tell us whether our programs are working, and turn them into actionable insights

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* 7\+ years of technical program management experience, with at least 3 years running security programs
* A track record of owning a vulnerability management program at scale: SLAs, remediation tracking across teams you don't control, executive reporting, and measurable risk reduction
* Technical fluency to be credible with security engineers: you can read a finding, understand severity and exploitability, and push back on a risk rating with reasons.
* Knows the common SaaS tools (okta, Slack,GSuite etc) of an enterprise stack well enough to talk through their security issues with the teams that own them.
* Deep hands\-on experience with agile execution: sprint planning, OKR frameworks, ticketing systems (Jira, Linear, or equivalent), documentation platforms like Confluence or Notion, and building program reporting in spreadsheets or BI dashboards.
* Writing that is clear, brief, and structured
* Ability to build strong working relationships across functions like IT, Legal, Compliance, and engineering, and execute through those partnerships: work gets done with other teams, not around them.
* Low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with diverse teams


The anticipated salary range for this role is between $243,000 \- $284,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.



This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave.

**a16z culture**
----------------


* We do only first class business and only in a first class way
* We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business
* We believe in the future and bet the firm that way
* We are all different, we recognize that, and we win
* We celebrate the good times
* We do it for the team
* We play to win


At a16z we are always looking to hire the absolute best talent and recognize that diversity in our experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. We hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. These differences are what enables us to work towards the future we envision for ourselves, our portfolio companies, and the World.



Our organization participates in E\-Verify. Click here to learn about E\-Verify.



Andreessen Horowitz hereby reserves the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes received from outside recruiting agencies and / or individual recruiters without being responsible for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Infrastructure Capacity Planning
jobs.description:
Technical Program Management \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI's Industrial Compute organization builds and operates the infrastructure required to train and serve frontier AI models. The Capacity Planning team connects rapidly changing research and product demand with the compute, networking, storage, power, data center, hardware, and operational resources required to make that demand executable.


**About the Role**


We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to build and lead capacity planning across OpenAI's large\-scale AI infrastructure. You will translate uncertain workload demand into clear infrastructure requirements, allocation decisions, supply commitments, activation priorities, and long\-range capacity strategies.


This role sits at the intersection of research, engineering, infrastructure, finance, sourcing, deployment, and operations. You will create the planning models, operating cadences, governance mechanisms, and source\-of\-truth systems that allow teams to understand what capacity is required, what is available, what is at risk, and what decisions must be made.


This is not a finance\-only forecasting or reporting role. Success requires technical fluency across the infrastructure stack, strong analytical judgment, and the ability to move consequential decisions forward when requirements, timelines, and supply conditions change quickly.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own capacity\-planning processes across near\-term workload allocation, quarterly execution, and longer\-range infrastructure horizons.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services is seeking a detail oriented, customer obsessed Program Manager for its Infrastructure Operations team.
  

  

Our Program Managers are able to quickly adapt strategies, plans and solutions in response to dynamic business requirements. They also must be comfortable interfacing and driving various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. If you have previous project engineering experience, are ready to take on challenges, open minded, appreciate team comradely, have an occasional sense of humor and want to help Amazon raise the bar, then this role is for you!  

  

Successful candidates are natural self\-starters who possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges while driving these solutions to completion. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams (internal operations, engineering, legal, finance, procurement, environmental/health/safety, etc.). This individual has strong communication skills, is organized and thrive in ambiguity.
  

  

The scope of role encompasses program management of capital expense (CAPEX) and/or operational expense (OPEX) projects within data center operations. The scope of projects will include but not be limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection, building improvements, vendor (partner) management, and cluster wide maintenance coordination. An understanding of these systems is necessary, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other teams and organizations.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Manage requirements, budget, design, and implementation of assigned projects  

  

Assess annual maintenance program requirements and build a rolling 18 month project forecast  

  

Facilitate creation of SOWs with partner teams to be included in contract documents including RFQ/RFPs, change order controls, purchase orders, and invoicing.  

  

Evaluate performance and work product of on\-site partners and escalate issues through Amazon leadership.  

  

Identify and communicate needs for design improvements.

Lead and coordinate design and execution efforts between internal teams and outside partners including equipment specifications, material flow, process design, and site layout.  

  

Evaluate project risks and issues and propose actionable resolutions.  

  

Build strong working relationships with data center leadership teams across multiple sites as well as other internal stakeholders (operations, finance, safety, security, legal, procurement).  

  

General knowledge of data center operations and facility management.  

  

Track record for being detail\-oriented with a demonstrated ability to self\-motivate and follow\-through on projects  

  

Ability to follow accurate and complete support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries.  

  

Proactively and continually improve your level of knowledge about data center relevant technologies.
  

  

About the team  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

jobs.title: Senior Fulfillment and Logistics Data Analyst
jobs.description:
As one of the technology industry's most desirable employers, NVIDIA is an industry leader in high performance computing, gaming and AI. NVIDIA's GPUs are extraordinary in performance and efficiency, and we are continually innovating in creative ways to deliver outstanding solutions in a wide range of sectors. We are looking for a Senior Fulfillment \& Logistics Data Analyst to provide advanced analytics, operational insights, and data\-supported solutions spanning our international fulfillment, warehousing, and transportation network. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in innovation at a company that is setting the stage for the future of computing!


This role will convert detailed Fulfillment \& Logistics data into useful intelligence that improves delivery performance, warehouse management, cycle time, inventory accuracy, transportation efficiency, cost, and customer experience.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Develop and maintain end\-to\-end analytics across inbound transportation, warehouse operations, inventory, outbound fulfillment, transportation, and final delivery.
* Analyze operational performance to identify bottlenecks, process gaps, capacity constraints, and opportunities to improve cycle time and service levels.
* Conduct root\-cause and Pareto analysis to identify systemic drivers of operational failures and recurring exceptions.
* Develop predictive and exception\-based analytics that allow operations teams to identify risks before they impact customers.
* Develop and sustain scalable dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent BI platforms.
* Extract, merge, and analyze data from enterprise systems including SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP TM, TMS, WMS, ERP, CRM, carrier platforms, and logistics visibility systems.
* Identify master\-data issues impacting fulfillment execution, including product dimensions, weights, country of origin, packaging information, carrier data, and warehouse master data.
* Find opportunities to apply AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, and automation to fulfillment and logistics operations.

**What We Need to See:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related area (or equivalent experience).
* Over 12 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, fulfillment, operations analytics, or business intelligence.
* Strong experience analyzing warehouse, transportation, inventory, order fulfillment, or supply chain performance data.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Tableau, Power BI, or similar data visualization software.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, and SAP TM.
* Experience with Python, R, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar analytical/data platforms.
* Knowledge of global transportation, freight forwarding, customs, warehousing, reverse logistics, and fulfillment operations.
* Experience working within high\-growth, technology, semiconductor, AI infrastructure, or data\-center supply chains.

**Ways to Stand Out from the crowd:**

* Analytical Depth: Ability to move beyond reporting what happened to explaining why it happened and what action should be taken.
* Supply Chain Acumen: Strong understanding of how warehouse, inventory, transportation, and fulfillment processes interact.
* Data Storytelling: Ability to convert complex datasets into concise, executive\-level insights.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**


Construction is a trillion dollar industry that still runs on manual work. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings by hand, and it takes forever. Bobyard uses AI to automate takeoffs and estimates so bids get done 10x faster. We're Series A, backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear, and revenue is doubling quarter over quarter.

**About the role**


As our first data hire, you will lay the foundation for our company\-wide data architecture and analytics strategy. You will design, build, and maintain our data pipeline and warehousing infrastructure, centralize fragmented data sources, and establish reliable metric definitions across the organization. In this role, you will work closely with cross\-functional leadership to deliver actionable insights, build high\-impact dashboards, and enable data\-informed decision\-making at every level of the business.

**What you'll do**

* Architect, scale, and maintain our central data warehouse and scalable ELT/ETL pipelines across internal systems
* Design robust data models and data transformation layers to turn raw operational data into clean, production\-ready datasets
* Establish, document, and standardize core business metrics and KPIs to ensure organizational alignment
* Deliver executive\- and operational\-level reporting, performance tracking, and analytical models for company leadership
* Develop intuitive BI dashboards and self\-service analytics tools for teams across business operations, product, and strategy
* Partner directly with key stakeholders across departments to identify analytical needs and answer strategic business questions
* Write clean, efficient, and well\-tested SQL and code to automate ingestion, data quality monitoring, and reporting
* Implement automated data validation, quality assurance tests, and governance practices as our data ecosystem matures

**What we're looking for**

* 5\+ years in analytics, analytics engineering, or business intelligence
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
* Advanced SQL and hands\-on data modeling with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
* Python for ETL and ELT work — API pulls, scripts, scheduled jobs
* You've built a data warehouse and its pipelines from scratch at a company under a few hundred people
* Real fluency in a B2B revenue funnel — you know what pipeline, CAC, and net revenue retention mean and why they move
* You can define a metric, defend the definition, and get a sales leader to adopt it

**Nice to have**

* BigQuery or a GCP data stack
* HubSpot as a source system
* Experience building financial or data controls, or supporting a SOC 2 audit
* You were the first data hire somewhere before

**What we offer**

* $140K–$160K base \+ equity
* Medical, dental, and vision, and a 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* The whole data function to build, with the CEO reading what you ship
* On\-site in SF at 101 Second Street — we build together

We are proud to offer competitive, top\-of\-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance\-based rewards.


Compensation Range: $140K \- $160K

new_jobs.description:
### **About us**



Pomelo Care is the leading virtual medical practice for women and children, providing care across pregnancy, postpartum, pediatrics, menopause, and perimenopause. We combine proactive, 24/7 clinical care with technology that helps us reach patients earlier, identify risks sooner, and deliver personalized care throughout their journey. Our team includes clinicians, technologists, operators, and problem\-solvers working together to make high\-quality care more accessible for families nationwide.

### **About The Role:**


**Your north star:** To serve as a trusted strategic partner that enables sustainable growth and high\-quality patient care through rigorous financial stewardship, data\-driven insights, and operational excellence.



As the Senior Revenue Cycle Strategy and Operations Manager, you will sit at the intersection of strategic RCM, financial collaboration, data analytics, and operational project management. In our fast\-growing startup environment, we operate across multiple complex lines of business, ranging from a per engaged member per month (PEMPM) capitation model to highly specialized Fee\-For\-Service (FFS) lines with new novel models being piloted. In this role, you will step up to navigate complex commercial agreements to secure high\-value partnerships and improve deal velocity, design novel FFS/PEMPM hybrid billing structures to unlock additional revenue opportunities, and serve as the dedicated resource for high\-level RCM escalations that currently flow directly to leadership.



This role reports to the Head of RCM and is open to any candidates located in the continental US.


**What you'll do:**


* Partner with Finance and Sales to design competitive pricing strategies, build hybrid FFS/PEMPM billing models, and lead RCM onboarding for new B2B clients.
* Serve as the dedicated resolution point for high\-level RCM escalations to streamline operations and protect leadership bandwidth.
* Collaborate with internal tech teams to build, optimize, and scale proprietary RCM software, maintaining data integrity across EHRs, clearinghouses, and BI platforms.
* Monitor regulatory updates, healthcare policy shifts, and payer rule changes to evaluate their financial impact and adapt systems preemptively.
* Use BI tools and advanced financial modeling to analyze key performance metrics, audit billing workflows, reconcile payments, and surface denial patterns.
* Develop quality assurance frameworks, standard operating procedures, and audit guidelines to elevate operational rigor.
* Oversee day\-to\-day revenue cycle execution—including claims submission, clearinghouse error resolution, payment posting, and root\-cause denial prevention.


**Who You Are:**


* 5–7 years of healthcare revenue cycle experience, ideally within a healthcare startup, digital health company, or a multi\-specialty group.
* Proven ability to partner with Finance to design pricing structures and collaborate with Product/Tech to build scalable operational tools.
* Deep understanding of commercial and Medicaid insurance billing, claim formats, and denial resolution.
* Experience leading coding discussions and navigating non\-traditional or emerging healthcare benefits (like doula care or value\-based capitation models) is highly preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel. Experience writing basic SQL or using BI tools like Metabase, Tableau, or Looker to pull data is highly preferred, alongside leveraging AI to improve efficiency and effectiveness of work products.
* Proven track record of managing high\-impact projects, implementing new software configurations, and building cross\-departmental consensus as a senior individual contributor.
* A builder and a strategist. You thrive in ambiguity, take pride in resolving complex organizational headwinds, and enjoy designing "how things should work" rather than just following an old playbook.

### **Why you should join our team**



By joining Pomelo, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast\-moving, well\-funded, and mission\-driven startup that always puts the patient first. You will learn, grow and be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.



We strive to create an environment where employees from all backgrounds are respected. We value working across disciplines, moving fast, data\-driven decision making, learning, and always putting the patient first.


**Benefits and Perks:**


* Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees and their families
* High deductible Health Plans with Health Savings Account (HSA) options
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Equity grant participation
* 401(k) program
* Competitive vacation policy
* 16 weeks paid parental leave
* Fully remote work flexibility (within the US)


**Compensation:**


The expected base salary range offered for this role is $135,000\-$150,000\. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and equity, giving you an ownership stake in Pomelo's mission. Actual compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.



At Pomelo, we are committed to hiring the best team to improve outcomes for all mothers and babies, regardless of their background. We need diverse perspectives to reflect the diversity of problems we face and the population we serve. We look to hire people from a variety of backgrounds, including but not limited to race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status.

This role is about analysis, not tool\-building: the work uses existing USDA data and existing tools (Excel, Power BI or similar, and standard analytical software) to answer questions the program needs answered.

**About the team**
------------------

The HR Compliance team is part of Zillow's Employee Service \& Operations (ES\&O) organization. ES\&O focuses on delivering scalable, reliable services that support employees and managers across the company, bringing together operational expertise, systems, and shared services that enable Zillow's people processes to run smoothly.
  

Within ES\&O, the HR Compliance team serves as Zillow's center of expertise for HR compliance — establishing the standards, guardrails, and governance frameworks that keep people practices legally sound as the business grows. The team partners closely with the broader People organization, Legal, and other shared services to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance, enabling operational teams to execute compliantly and consistently.

The Program Manager, HR Compliance is a subject matter expert responsible for helping strengthen Zillow's HR compliance program across a defined and expanding portfolio of programs.


This role supports regulatory monitoring, risk assessment, and policy governance work that allows the team to monitor and respond to changes in employment laws and regulations, identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risk, and equip HR partners with the guidance they need to operate compliantly. You will establish standards, playbooks, and controls for teams to execute against.

**Who are we?**


Founded in 2005, Pierce Washington helps clients transform their quote\-to\-cash process. We are creating a next\-generation Total Commerce Company and will own the Total Commerce category – a fast growing segment in the tech industry. This is the place to come to if you want to work with the best, get in at the ground floor and help sustain and grow one of the best places to work. We have completed over 100 CPQ projects enabling leading enterprise companies to achieve their most complex Q2C process automation goals and transform how they do business.


Leveraging this expertise, our Salesforce Practice is focused on delivering Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions to clients in the High Tech and Manufacturing industries. Come join a growing Salesforce Practice and work on fun projects with good people!

**Who are you?**


You are an experienced Salesforce Project Manager, who has experience managing enterprise level projects. You enjoy being a hands\-on business analyst while managing complex projects and delivering excellence for your clients. As the client’s main point of contact, you will establish a comprehensive understanding of project expectations and business processes and manage a plan to meet these goals.


You strive for and deliver excellence for yourself, your team, and your clients. * Serve as an expert in Agile methodology to effectively apply our delivery methodology and enforce project standards
* Ensure successful completion of project deliverables, cost, and timelines
* Maintain a sense of ownership as it pertains to client satisfaction, company profitability and project team resource workload

**What you bring to the role:**


4\+ years of Salesforce industry experience in a consulting capacity as a Business Analyst and/or Project Manager working with the Sales Could and/or Service Cloud * \- **must have experience managing enterprise level projects**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience managing E**nterprise Salesforce CPQ** projects that were at least 6 months in duration and included data migrations and integrations with ERP systems
* Experience with Salesforce org consolidation/migration projects a bonus
* Proven expert in Agile SDLC project management theories, practices and methods
* Ability to serve as a liaison between both business and technical teams to drive effective, timely solutions that fulfill both strategic and operational needs
* Experienced in executing gap analysis and requirements traceability matrices
* Excellent client\-facing written and oral communication skills
* Ability to pivot and adapt in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to challenge, innovate, lead and drive projects to close
* Experienced with Visio, Jira, Confluence, Prodly, Copado, or similar tools desirable
* Experience in the High Tech or Manufacturing industries highly desired
* PMP certification is preferred
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire within first several months
* Preferred Salesforce certifications: Administrator
* Experience in High Tech or Manufacturing industries highly desired
* Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science or information systems

**What we’ll do for you:**

* Competitive compensation package
* Health, vision, dental, life \& disability insurance
* Flexible, collaborative work environment with a commitment to work life balance
* Work anywhere, with full remote and hybrid options depending on location
* Learn and challenge yourself in a fast\-paced, growing tech company

**More about us:**


Since 2005, Pierce Washington has helped enterprises transform their quote\-to\-cash process in four ways: we implement CPQ, eCommerce and Billing \& Subscription Management solutions and we integrate those solutions to ERP and other enterprise systems. By focusing on these four areas – and doing them well – we have built our reputation
